verification.precondition: A committed evidence record persists one operationDigest in its authenticated JournalRecord and exactly linked idempotency outcome entry.
verification.stimulus: First rewrite the journal operationDigest while publicly recomputing the record and root seals but not its authentication, then independently rewrite only the outcome operationDigest under a recomputed physical root seal.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Cold construction rejects the unauthenticated journal rewrite and backing import rejects the outcome-to-journal identity mismatch.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: persisted operation identity rejects unauthenticated journal and outcome-link tampering
verification.forbiddenMutation: Neither a publicly resealed journal rewrite nor an unlinked outcome view may become an admitted replay root.

behavior: persisted operation identity rejects unauthenticated journal and outcome-link tampering
